records.description: The unique identifier for the LFI within the CBUAE ecosystem
The unique identifier for the LFI Brand within the CBUAE ecosystem
A data holder specific unique identifier for this product. This identifier must be unique to a product but does not otherwise need to adhere to ID permanence guidelines.
The display name of the product.
The supported product category codes for banking products.
A human-readable description of the product that can be displayed to the User for marketing and information purposes.

The date and time from which this product is effective (i.e. is available for origination). Used to enable the articulation of products to the regime before they are available for customers to originate.
The date and time at which this product will be retired and will no longer be offered. Used to enable the managed deprecation of products.
The last date and time that the information for this product was changed (or the creation date for the product if it has never been altered).
Indicates whether the product is Sharia-compliant.
Provides the Islamic finance contract or structure type applied to a product when it has been confirmed as Sharia-compliant.
If the product is Shari'a Compliant, alternative brand name to sell the product.
The description of the Sharia compliance information.
Does the Consumer need to pay their salary into a current account provided by the LFI to be able to open this product.
